info.title: Urja Meter API
info.description: A clean API over the legacy Urja Meter Ops portal: meters, their network position, transformers and data quality. All /v1 routes need an API key. Errors are RFC 9457 problem+json. How the portal works underneath is documented in PROTOCOL.md.

get.description: Never touches the portal. For container health checks.

get.summary: Readiness: is the catalog loaded, and how fresh is it?
get.description: Answers 503 with ready=false until the first catalog load succeeds, so a load balancer can wait.

circuit.description: open = the portal failed repeatedly; calls are paused.

portal.description: Health of the connection to the legacy portal (null when not wired).

get.summary: Energy readings: half-hourly, or summed per hour or day
get.description: The portal stores cumulative registers every 30 minutes. This returns them with the usage of each half hour (the difference to the previous reading), power factor, and optional hourly or daily totals. Without from/to you get the 7 days ending at the newest reading. A window is at most 31 days. History currently covers 1 to 30 June 2026 (PROTOCOL.md 3.3). Times are IST (+05:30).

parameters.name: meterId
parameters.description: Meter ID, e.g. J100001 (case-insensitive).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the window, inclusive. A date means 00:00 IST that day; a date-time without an offset is read as IST.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the window, exclusive. A date-only value includes that whole day (to=2026-06-30 ends at 1 July 00:00 IST).

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: raw = every half-hourly reading; hour/day = usage summed per IST hour or day.

timezone.description: All times are IST; the portal has no other timezone.

get.summary: Transformer loading: demand of its meters per half hour against its kVA rating
get.description: Sums the apparent power (kVAh x 2) of the DT's meters per half hour and compares the peak with the rating from /portal/dts. A lower bound on real loading: line losses and unmetered load are not visible. Flags 80%+ as warning, 100%+ as critical.

get.summary: Bulk export of meters as flat rows (JSON or CSV), no paging
get.description: Every meter that matches the same filters as GET /v1/meters, in one response, flattened to one row per meter with the full network position, transformer rating and data-issue codes. get.summary: Bulk export of readings for many meters (JSON or CSV)
get.description: Readings for a transformer, a network node or a list of meters (at most 50 meters), in long format: one row per meter per half hour, hour or day. Same window rules as GET /v1/meters/{meterId}/readings (at most 31 days; without from/to, the 7 days ending at the newest reading). One portal call per meter, at most 4 at a time, cached afterwards. Meters that fail are listed under `failed` (JSON) and left out of the rows. `format=csv` returns a CSV file download.
